name: Hubitat Core
description: Shared Hubitat Elevation connection for the hubitat_* widget family. Enable the built-in Maker API app on your hub (Apps → Add Built-In App → Maker API), tick the devices to expose, then paste the app's base URL and access token once here. Every hubitat widget reads live device attributes from it over plain REST. No cell of its own.

settings.name: api_url
settings.label: Maker API base URL (e.g. http://192.168.1.20/apps/api/12, or the cloud form https://cloud.hubitat.com/api/<hub-id>/apps/12)

settings.name: temperature_unit
settings.label: Temperature unit shown next to temperature attributes (F or C; the hub's own scale, Settings → Hub Details → Temperature Scale)

settings.name: verify_tls
settings.label: Verify TLS certificate (uncheck for a hub on self-signed HTTPS)
